name: nfs-no-root-squash
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: installs the NFS server (if needed) and adds an export with no_root_squash (remote root writes as local root). Paired check wants no_root_squash gone. Vars: EXPORT_PATH (optional, default /srv/relay-share).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
command -v exportfs >/dev/null 2>&1 || { apt-get update -y >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; apt-get install -y nfs-kernel-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
path="${EXPORT_PATH:-/srv/relay-share}"
install -d -m 0755 "$path"
line="$path  *(rw,sync,no_root_squash,no_subtree_check)"
grep -qF "$line" /etc/exports 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' "$line" >> /etc/exports
exportfs -ra >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
systemctl restart nfs-kernel-server >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
